name: Mighty Sparrow
description: '''Slinger Francisco''' [[Order of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago|ORTT]] [[Chaconia Medal|CM]] [[Order of the British Empire|OBE]], [[Order of the Caribbean Community|OCC]] (9 July 1935 – 27 September 2026), better known as '''Mighty Sparrow''', was a Trinidadian [[Calypso music|calypso]] vocalist, songwriter and guitarist. Known as the "Calypso King of the World", he was one of the best-known and most successful [[calypsonian]]s. Francisco won Trinidad's [[Carnival Road March]] competition eight times, [[Calypso Monarch|Calypso King/Monarch]] eight times, and twice won the Calypso King of Kings title.
